{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Water-resistant trench coat, classic A-line cut, knee-length, charcoal grey (#36454F), cotton gabardine.
Relaxed-fit wool blend sweater, crew neck with ribbed cuffs, hip-length, heather navy (#485563), fine merino wool.
High-waisted straight-leg trousers, tapered ankle, full-length, deep forest green (#1C2B22), heavy-weight technical twill.
Chunky leather combat boots, flat sole with lug tread, calf-high, black oxblood (#3B0808), smooth calfskin.

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn coffee meeting because the trench coat provides essential protection against the continuous rain while maintaining a professional silhouette suitable for seeing a client. The relaxed sweater and high-waisted trousers offer comfort and ease of movement, allowing her to sit comfortably throughout the conversation without feeling restricted. Finally, the dark, earthy tones create a flattering, grounded look that balances the cozy weather with a polished yet approachable business casual aesthetic."}
